## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
RISK-ON. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: broad sector breadth ≥7/11 and cyclicals leading (Industrials/Energy/Financials strength via DE, OXY, JPM); Leadership: Concentrated (Top 5 span 3 sectors).

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Industrials lead: DE (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +25.11%) ABOVE TREND, GE (1W: +9.69% | 1M: +7.76%) ABOVE TREND. Energy strong: OXY (1W: +13.96% | 1M: +19.15%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +0.84% | 1M: +10.32%) ABOVE TREND; style: Value/Cyclical.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Materials weak: NUE (1W: -4.66% | 1M: -0.12%) BELOW TREND, DOW (1W: -6.52% | 1M: +7.43%) CORRECTION. Consumer Staples soft: WMT (1W: -7.97% | 1M: +3.04%) CORRECTION, EL (1W: +7.34% | 1M: -3.09%) RECOVERY. Technology shows mixed internals with several large-cap names BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: AMAT (1W: +14.31% | 1M: +15.42%) ABOVE TREND; SHOP (1W: +14.04% | 1M: -8.91%) RECOVERY; OXY (1W: +13.96% | 1M: +19.15%) ABOVE TREND; DE (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +25.11%) ABOVE TREND; GE (1W: +9.69% | 1M: +7.76%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Concentrated (3 sectors in Top 5) — cyclical names dominate.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: PANW (1W: -8.67% | 1M: -18.06%) BELOW TREND; WMT (1W: -7.97% | 1M: +3.04%) CORRECTION; DOW (1W: -6.52% | 1M: +7.43%) CORRECTION; ORCL (1W: -5.37% | 1M: -14.84%) BELOW TREND; INTC (1W: -5.10% | 1M: -18.69%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in select Tech and Materials names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Strongest 1W: AMAT (1W: +14.31% | 1M: +15.42%) ABOVE TREND, SHOP (1W: +14.04% | 1M: -8.91%) RECOVERY, OXY (1W: +13.96% | 1M: +19.15%) ABOVE TREND — watch PYPL (1W: +6.58% | 1M: -25.48%) RECOVERY and AMZN (1W: +5.27% | 1M: -9.17%) RECOVERY for major divergence. Major divergence present (≥3 large names showing 1W ≠ 1M) — treat regime as tactical, watch for trend confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Mixed with internal rotation: AAPL (1W: +1.09% | 1M: +6.94%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +1.54% | 1M: +3.55%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: -1.15% | 1M: -10.56%) BELOW TREND, GOOGL (1W: +1.94% | 1M: -4.08%) RECOVERY. Sector shows short-term strength but notable 1M weakness—monitor large-cap leadership.

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Financials constructive: JPM (1W: +2.69% | 1M: +2.90%) ABOVE TREND, PYPL (1W: +6.58% | 1M: -25.48%) RECOVERY, V (1W: -1.00% | 1M: -1.13%) BELOW TREND. Sector breadth positive and supports the RISK-ON backdrop; stylistic tilt toward Value/Cyclicals.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Defensive mix with rotation signs: JNJ (1W: -0.84% | 1M: +11.23%) CORRECTION, UNH (1W: +1.98% | 1M: -16.61%) RECOVERY, LLY (1W: -2.61% | 1M: -6.24%) BELOW TREND. Sector breadth mild positive; watch earnings/news-driven moves.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor exposure to cyclicals and Financials (examples: DE (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +25.11%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +13.96% | 1M: +19.15%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +2.69% | 1M: +2.90%) ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to structurally weak large-cap Tech/Software names (ORCL (1W: -5.37% | 1M: -14.84%) BELOW TREND, INTC (1W: -5.10% | 1M: -18.69%) BELOW TREND). Style: Value/Cyclical preferred, but major divergence advises selective sizing and confirmation.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: DE (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +25.11%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +14.31% | 1M: +15.42%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +5.89% | 1M: +7.24%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: WMT (1W: -7.97% | 1M: +3.04%) CORRECTION, ORCL (1W: -5.37% | 1M: -14.84%) BELOW TREND, TSLA (1W: -1.26% | 1M: -4.55%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Industrials (1W: +2.11% | 1M: +8.19%) — watch DE/CAT; Energy (1W: +2.12% | 1M: +11.72%) — OXY/CVX. BEARISH: Materials (1W: -0.50% | 1M: +7.01%) and Consumer Staples (1W: -0.28% | 1M: +7.44%) for relative weakness and headline sensitivity.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
NVDA (1W: +1.54% | 1M: +3.55%) ABOVE TREND — trigger: sustained push above recent monthly highs for momentum confirmation. AAPL (1W: +1.09% | 1M: +6.94%) ABOVE TREND — trigger: hold monthly trend for rotation plays. JPM (1W: +2.69% | 1M: +2.90%) ABOVE TREND — trigger: breakout above recent resistance to confirm Financials leadership.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
DE (+80): DE (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +25.11%) ABOVE TREND — earnings/guidance bull story confirmed by price. PFE (+55): PFE (1W: -2.99% | 1M: +4.66%) CORRECTION — trial news positive but 1W weakness is a short-term divergence. WMT (+50): WMT (1W: -7.97% | 1M: +3.04%) CORRECTION — price action diverges from bullish headlines, watch follow-through.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
TSLA (-60): TSLA (1W: -1.26% | 1M: -4.55%) BELOW TREND — negative headlines confirm recent weakness. BA (-60): BA (1W: -3.06% | 1M: -7.21%) BELOW TREND — sentiment aligns with price deterioration. EL (-50): EL (1W: +7.34% | 1M: -3.09%) RECOVERY — downgrade-driven negative sentiment but 1W strength is a divergence; monitor for distribution.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON, Value/Cyclical style.  
Cyclicals showing strength — DE (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +25.11%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +13.96% | 1M: +19.15%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +14.31% | 1M: +15.42%) ABOVE TREND.  
Key risk: major divergence across several large names (AMZN, GOOGL, PYPL, SHOP) and mixed sentiment (PFE/WMT) — watch for trend confirmation before enlarging positions.
